title: Fresno Cops Fire at Robbery Suspects Who Stole Safe from Apartment
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Fresno, California — On January 26, 2025, at 7:20 a.m., Fresno Police Officers responded to an apartment complex at North Backer Avenue and Shaw Avenue regarding a burglary in progress. A 9-1-1 caller reported seeing three armed men breaking into an apartment. Surveillance video captured the suspects approaching the victim's residence. One suspect is armed with a shotgun that was later recovered. After forcing their way inside the victim's apartment, one of the suspects drove their SUV onto the courtyard and backed it up near the apartment's front door. The suspects removed a safe from the apartment and loaded it into the back of the SUV. After partially loading the safe in the SUV, they drove out of the courtyard but were met by arriving Fresno Police Officers. Officer #1 located the SUV stopped on a walkway with two of the subjects outside of the vehicle. Officer #1 gave the suspects multiple commands to get on the ground, but they did not comply and they re-entered the SUV. The driver of the SUV backed up, struck a building, and then rapidly accelerated towards officer #1. Officer #1 discharged his service weapon. 

As the suspects fled from the apartment complex, assisting officers initiated a pursuit. When the suspect vehicle drove out of the parking lot, officer #3 intentionally collided with the vehicle. Officer #3 observed the driver, 37-year-old Amicho Mancia, attempting to pull a rifle out before he fled from the vehicle. Officer #3 fired multiple rounds through the windshield of his patrol vehicle. Amicho Mancia then fled from the vehicle and ran westbound towards the campus. Officer #2 exited his vehicle as Amicho Mancia began to flee. Officer #2 believed the suspect was armed and fired his service weapon. Amicho Mancia continued to flee and a police k9 was deployed, apprehending him. Officer #3's body-worn camera was activated after the collision with the suspect vehicle. Officer #3 discharged his service weapon from inside his vehicle and through the windshield. As officers approached the suspect vehicle to detain the passenger, later identified as 43-year-old Antwoine Francisco Mancia, officer #3 sees the assault rifle Amicho Mancia was attempting to pull out. Officer #3 secured the assault rifle, and Antwoine Mancia was taken into custody. 

As officers were providing medical aid to the driver, Amicho Mancia, they observed he had a gunshot wound and he was wearing body armor. Amicho Mancia was transported to the hospital in stable condition and admitted for further treatment. The passenger, Antwoine Mancia, did not have any visible injuries but complained of pain. He was transported to the hospital, released, and booked into jail. Amicho Mancia was booked into jail for felony assault on an officer, robbery, and a felon in possession of a firearm. Antwoine Mancia was booked into jail for robbery, carrying a concealed firearm, a felon in possession of a firearm and a felon in possession of ammunition. The body armor worn by Amicho Mancia did not have any bullet impacts. The firearm recovered from the suspect vehicle was an ar-15 style rifle. The shotgun and bag that was carried by one of the suspects were recovered inside the victim's residence. The safe fell out of the SUV as the suspects fled from the apartment complex. The third suspect involved in the home invasion robbery, 28-year-old Aaron Guery, was identified by detectives and taken into custody on January 29, 2025. He was booked into jail for home invasion robbery.
